pkgmetadata.longdescription: GAIA is a lightweight agent framework by AMD for building and running AI agents on edge devices and AI PCs. It supports local LLMs via OpenAI-compatible APIs, RAG, voice, MCP, and a web UI.

use.flag: Enable PyTorch-based audio support (torch, torchvision, torchaudio)
Enable RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) with faiss and document parsing
Enable the web UI server (requires PyTorch and RAG deps)
